charge_port.notes: Estimated: BMW i4 keeps a CCS1 port through 2026 (thinkEV 2026 eDrive40 lists CCS1; Lectron lists the i4 2022-2026 as a CCS-to-NACS adapter car; BMW Canada says native NACS is only on all-new 2026+ models such as iX3/i3). Same port assumed for 2024.

supercharger_access.notes: Canada: BMW says all BEVs except original i3/MINI SE become Supercharger-compatible by remote software upgrade and CCS cars use the approved Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter (access from 2026-04-08; i4 not named in the text read).

Estimated: US access from the week of 2025-12-10 for i4/i5/i7/iX with an adapter; InsideEVs says 2025 cars should work and compatibility varies by model year; Lectron lists i4 2022-2026. Older years assumed to work like 2025 (same CCS hardware).

wheels.notes: M50: 19 x 8.5 front / 19 x 9 rear aluminum, P245/40R19 and P255/40R19. (US page; Canadian cars assumed the same.)
M50: Cooling & High Performance Tire Package includes 20 in M bicolor wheels (Style 868M), 20 x 8.5 front / 20 x 10 rear. (US page; Canadian cars assumed the same.)
